event.title: Internal Hackathon (Smart India Hackathon 2026)
event.tagline: Ideate, Prototype, and Pitch – The Road to SIH 2026
event.location: Online (Google Meet) & Reading Room, Keshav Mahavidyalaya
event.summary: Keshav Mahavidyalaya conducted the Internal Hackathon under SIH 2026 in two rounds — online prelims on 3–4 September and an offline hackathon on 10 September 2026 — giving students a platform to ideate, prototype, and pitch solutions aligned with the national-level SIH format.
event.description: Keshav Mahavidyalaya successfully conducted the Internal Hackathon under Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 in two structured parts. The first part, held online on 3–4 September 2026, served as a mock-presentation and prelims screening round. The second part, the offline internal hackathon, was conducted on 10 September 2026 in the Reading Room, where nominated teams presented refined solutions for final evaluation.
highlights: 21 teams (126 participants) in online prelims; 19 teams (114 participants) in offline finals
Evaluated by faculty panel on a 100-mark rubric
HEXCODE and Team Tiramisu jointly topped with 87 marks each

sessions.title: Round-1: Online Mock Presentation / Prelims Screening
sessions.description: 21 teams presented proposed solutions over Google Meet; 19 were nominated to proceed.

sessions.title: Round-2: Offline Internal Hackathon
sessions.description: 19 nominated teams presented refined solutions before a faculty panel for final evaluation.

winners.title: Team Tiramisu — Quality Assessment and Grading of Onions (SIH26031)
Embiot — AI-enabled Mine Subsidence Monitoring System (SIH26025)

outcomes: Top-performing teams to represent Keshav Mahavidyalaya in SIH 2026
